MediaFile is the leaf and Collection the composite.
totalSize(), countFiles() and contains() are resolved
recursively over the tree; the leaf ends the recursion.
Collections can be nested inside collections.
adding: a collection cannot contain itself
or any of its ancestors. Composite invariant.
Separate aggregate: it references the file and the user

Sharing a collection creates a guest User
(User.createGuest) with permission on it, and a
link that points to that guest. Whoever uses the
link gets a token for that user, so authorization
works exactly as for any other user.

writes the aggregate and pullEvents() to the outbox
